title: Braised Baby Potatoes in Kosher Sauce
description: Tender baby potatoes slow-cooked in a rich and savory kosher sauce, perfect as a side dish or accompaniment to your favorite meats.
instructions: Heat the kosher sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the halved potatoes to the saucepan and stir to coat with the sauce and onion mixture.
Reduce heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or chives if desired.
